name: Raene's Cleansing
summary: In Ashenvale, Raene Wolfrunner and Shael'dryn seek the last piece of Dartol's Rod. They hope the relic can cleanse the forest and slow the furbolg attacks on its night elves.

sections.title: The Ruins of Dor'Danil
sections.body: At Dor'Danil barrow den, night elf druids guarded the iron pommel of Dartol's Rod. Disaster struck, and the druids were slain. Their refuge fell, and the pommel's hiding place was lost. Now scavengers and wandering oozes consume what remains in the ruins east of the southern road.

sections.title: Rebuilding Dartol's Legacy
sections.body: Dartol was an evil wizard, and he has died. Yet the rod he made holds powers that can transform. Raene Wolfrunner and Shael'dryn seek to reassemble it, hoping it can slow the furbolg attacks on Ashenvale's night elves. The iron pommel is the last piece Shael'dryn needs before she can try to mend the broken rod at the moonwell.

faq.answer: The iron pommel is the final piece of Dartol's Rod. Without it, the relic cannot be reforged or channeled to cleanse Ashenvale.

faq.q: What happened to the druids of Dor'Danil?
faq.answer: The druids at Dor'Danil barrow den were slain when their sanctuary fell. Oozes and beasts now haunt their abandoned refuge, and Shael'dryn finds their fate painful to discuss.
Dor'Danil lies in southern Ashenvale, east of the main road toward the Barrens border and south of Splintertree Post.
Shael'dryn is a dryad who tends a sacred moonwell in Ashenvale. She helps Raene Wolfrunner find the scattered pieces of Dartol's Rod and guides its repair.

faq.q: Why is the pommel swallowed by oozes?
faq.answer: After the barrow den fell, gelatinous slimes infested the area and consumed discarded relics, chests, and corpses. The oozes engulfed the iron pommel with the other debris.

faq.q: What happens after finding the pommel?
faq.answer: When you return the pommel to Shael'dryn, she can begin repairing the rod. Once mended, it can help Raene Wolfrunner cleanse the forest.

angles.text: As a druid, you see the losses suffered by the Cenarion Circle and Kaldorei druids in Ashenvale when you visit Dor'Danil's desecrated grounds.
As a night elf, recovering Dartol's heirloom honors Dor'Danil's fallen caretakers and the defense of ancient Kaldorei lands.
As an Alliance member, you know Ashenvale's defense against corruption matters to the Alliance's hold on northern Kalimdor, with Horde forces advancing from Splintertree.
